Operating rules for every agent in this project. Read before AGENTS.md.
Project `stimming` · type: coding · vault: `Claude Cabinet` · breadcrumb `.claude/adjudant` (git-ignored).
Verbs: `/adjudant connect | status | clean | dream | draw | board | orchestrate | merge | retire | ask | routine | intake`. The type's profile decides the set.

## Voice
Lead with the action. Never `Great question`, `Hope this helps`, `Let me know if`.
Number multi-step work. Cap lists at five. Restate state each turn. No em dashes.

## Code comments
The register is `.claude/rules/adjudant-code.md`; it loads when a code file is read or edited. ASD-STE100, double density, one fact per comment.

## Vault writes
All vault writes go through adjudant, never by hand. Two densities. Documentation (brief, decisions, reference notes): ASD-STE100 at double density. Session logs and working notes: ASD-STE100 at regular density.
STE governs the prose, not the format. Use markdown in full: tables, callouts, code, Mermaid diagrams. Never flatten a diagram into sentences.

## Partners
Adjudant expects these; the session banner says which are here.
- beans: work items and their checklists · hookify: drift-defense hooks from rule files
- remember: session memory across turns · superpowers: process skills, brainstorm to plan
The recommended and elective tiers, their channels and install lines: `/adjudant status` and the adjudant skill's `reference/partners.md`.
